notes.title: Big Demo Update!
notes.content:
[p]Here's a big update to the demo! I know things have been pretty quiet on Steam, and it's because we've spent all that time working on the game. If you want to see more progress updates, join our Discord at 
[url="https://discord.gg/tQJ4z2C5FB"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]CHANGELOG[/b] [/h3][list][*][p] Overhauled the soundtrack with new music variants that smoothly transition into each other depending on the state of the game. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Totally reworked piece scoring - a lot of people found the old system unintuitive, so we basically inverted it. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] Made the scoring animation easier to follow and a lot more satisfying - a number appears over each piece showing its total contribution, and that ticks up every time its score increases, then all of the individual piece scores fly into your counter. Check it out in game! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added as many visual effects and shaders as we had time to make - text animation, UI sway, shadows - and more are on the way! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Made a few minor balancing tweaks, like adjusting sell prices and rarities for some items. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Totally reworked the board select and profile menus. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bunch of bugs, naturally.[/p][/*][/list]
